title: Latin America in the Cold War: the Rio Treaty and the OAS
goal: I can say what the Rio Treaty and the OAS were, using se to say what was signed and founded.

items: I can say what the Rio Treaty of 1947 said.
I can say when and where the OAS was founded.
I can say what the charter said about intervention.
I can use *se* to say what was done without saying who did it.
I can say what was signed and founded using *se*.
I can explain what the Rio Treaty of 1947 said about an attack.
I can say when and where the OAS was founded.
I can name the principle of non-intervention in the OAS charter.
I can say which parties and governments were banned or excluded.
